newsitem.title: USA: Universal Forest sees margin opportunity.
newsitem.headline: Universal Forest sees margin opportunity.

text.p: Universal Forest Products Inc said it sees opportunity to improve its net margin during 1997 by selling more value-added products.

"As we begin 1997, we are in a strong position to drive increasing levels of profitable revenue growth," said chief executive William Currie. "We believe there is considerable opportunity to improve our net margin during 1997 by selling more value-added products."

The producer of wood products for the do-it-yourself retail and manufactured housing markets Wednesday reported record net earnings for 1996 of $17.8 million, or $1.00 per share, compared with $14.1 million, or $0.80 per share, a year ago. Net sales in 1996 rose 17 percent to $867.7 million compared with $739.3 million in 1995.
"During the past year, we grew top line sales with a focus on value-added products, and continued to improve asset utilization," Currie said.
